data.long_meaning: In Welsh, Blain means 'slender' or 'fair one'. This ancient Celtic name has been adopted into the Christian tradition and is often given to boys born into Welsh families. The name Blain carries the meaning “Slender, fair one” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Blain usually hope their child will grow to embody slender, fair one and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Blain total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.
